indication.text: Tekturna (aliskiren) is indicated for the treatment of hypertension; may be used alone or in combination with other antihypertensive agents.

citations.quote: Tekturna® (aliskiren) is indicated for the treatment of hypertension. It may be used alone or in combination with other antihypertensive agents. Use with maximal doses of ACE inhibitors has not been adequately studied.

target_moa.text: Aliskiren is an orally active, nonpeptide, direct renin inhibitor. It inhibits renin, the enzyme that cleaves angiotensinogen to angiotensin I, thereby reducing plasma renin activity (PRA), Ang I and Ang II.

citations.quote: Aliskiren, the active component of Tekturna® Tablets, is an orally active, nonpeptide, potent renin inhibitor.
Renin cleaves angiotensinogen to form the inactive decapeptide angiotensin I (Ang I).

citations.quote: Aliskiren, the active component of Tekturna® Tablets, is an orally active, nonpeptide, potent renin inhibitor. Aliskiren is present in Tekturna Tablets as its hemifumarate salt.

key_safety.text: Most common AE is dose-related diarrhea (2.3% at 300 mg vs 1.2% placebo); other increased events were rash (1% vs 0.3%), elevated uric acid (0.4% vs 0.1%), gout (0.2% vs 0.1%), and renal stones (0.2% vs 0%). Serious risks include angioedema (two cases with respiratory symptoms; rate 0.06%) and hypotension.

citations.quote: Diarrhea was reported by 2.3% of patients at 300 mg, compared to 1.2% in placebo patients.
Other adverse effects with increased rates for aliskiren compared to placebo included rash (1% vs. 0.3%), elevated uric acid (0.4% vs. 0.1%), gout (0.2% vs. 0.1%), and renal stones (0.2% vs. 0%).
Two cases of angioedema with respiratory symptoms were reported with aliskiren use in the clinical studies.
The rate of these angioedema cases in the completed studies was 0.06 %.

detail.text: Use in pregnancy warning: when used during the second and third trimesters, drugs that act directly on the renin-angiotensin system can cause injury and even death to the developing fetus; discontinue Tekturna as soon as pregnancy is detected.

citations.quote: **USE IN PREGNANCY:** When used in pregnancy during the second and third trimesters, drugs that act directly on the renin-angiotensin system can cause injury and even death to the developing fetus. When pregnancy is detected, Tekturna should be discontinued as soon as possible. See **WARNINGS:** **Fetal/Neonatal Morbidity and Mortality.**

detail.text: Application received February 13, 2006 and approved March 5, 2007 following review; no prior complete response/action cycle indicated.

citations.quote: We have completed our review of this application, as amended. It is approved, effective on the date of this letter, for use as recommended in the agreed-upon labeling text.

Please refer to your new drug application (NDA) dated February 10, 2006, received February 13, 2006, submitted under section 505(b)(1) of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act for Tekturna (aliskiren) 150 mg and 300 mg Tablets.

requirement.text: Include intestinal procedures/neoplasms and angioedema as events of special interest in the proposed ALTITUDE outcome trial and provide periodic safety summaries.

citations.quote: To include intestinal procedures and neoplasms and angioidema as events of special interest in your proposed ALTITUDE trial as detailed in their special protocol assessment letters.

requirement.text: Incorporate a colonoscopy substudy (colonoscopies at baseline and after >=12 months treatment) into the proposed long-term outcome study, powered to rule out a doubling in cancerous/precancerous lesions.

citations.quote: To incorporate a colonoscopy substudy into your proposed long-term outcome study. The colonoscopy substudy should include colonoscopies performed at baseline and after drug treatment for 12 months or longer. This study should be powered to rule out a doubling in the rate of cancerous or precancerous lesions.

requirement.text: Provide evidence regarding the clinical usefulness (or lack thereof) of twice-daily dosing in patients not controlled on the highest recommended once-daily dose.

citations.quote: You should provide evidence that it is not likely to be clinically useful to give aliskiren in a twice-daily dosing regimen to patients whose blood pressure is not controlled on the highest recommended dose given once daily.

summary.text: Tekturna (aliskiren), an oral direct renin inhibitor and the first renin inhibitor submitted for approval, was submitted as a 505(b)(1) NDA received February 13, 2006, given a Standard review designation, and approved March 5, 2007 for the treatment of hypertension based on five pivotal randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trials with a primary endpoint of change in seated trough cuff DBP; a PREA pediatric study was deferred as a postmarketing requirement.
